messages:
Diego Morales: hey all, first-day question — Kandji finished and FileVault is on, but i can't install Homebrew or Docker because my account isn't an admin. i'm a dev and need ephemeral sudo to install deps. what's the process?

Ava (IT): welcome Diego! we don't give permanent admin by default. we can do a temporary admin elevation for installs. two ways: (1) we run a Kandji action to add you to the local admin group for N minutes, or (2) we create a one-time sudo token for you. which do you prefer?

Diego Morales: Kandji action sounds fine. i just need about 45 minutes to install Homebrew and Docker Desktop.

Jordan (Device Admin): cool. drop your device serial and i'll run `GrantLocalAdmin` for 60 minutes. serial?

Diego Morales: serial C02DIEG12345. thank you!

Kandji-bot: Enrollment complete for "Diego Morales - MacBookPro16" at 2026-12-21T09:12:33Z. Applied profile: "New Hire - Dev".

Jordan (Device Admin): initiating action: `kandjictl runAction --device "C02DIEG12345" --action GrantLocalAdmin --params username=diego.morales duration_minutes=60` — running now. ping here when you see the admin prompt.

Security: FYI Security policy requires we audit local admin grants. Jordan, mark it as "temporary admin for package install" in the ticket. Diego, do not install packages that bypass our SBOM policy.

Diego Morales: prompt popped to allow Admin group membership. accepted. trying Homebrew install now: `NONINTERACTIVE=1 /bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"`

Ava (IT): heads up — for Docker Desktop on macOS Ventura+ we prefer the App Store or the official pkg. if Docker asks for additional system permissions grant them (we can assist).

Diego Morales: brew installed. starting Docker Desktop install — installer asked for kernel extension approval? it shows a system settings link for Security & Privacy to allow.

Jordan (Device Admin): macOS 14 uses virtualization.framework, but Docker Desktop still requests some privileged entitlements. If Security prompts show, click Allow in System Settings > Privacy & Security. If it asks for a restart, do it.

Diego Morales: granted privileges, Docker running. verified `docker version` and `docker run hello-world` succeeded. thanks!

Jordan (Device Admin): removing temporary admin now: `kandjictl runAction --device "C02DIEG12345" --action RemoveLocalAdmin --params username=diego.morales` — done. Diego, confirm you no longer have admin in System Settings > Users & Groups.

Diego Morales: confirmed back to standard user. `sudo ls` prompts for admin and denies my account. all good.

Helpdesk Bot: Ticket #INC-2026-2043 opened (Jordan)  Temporary admin grant for Diego Morales (serial C02DIEG12345) recorded. Duration: 60m.

Security: Logged and closed on our side. Jordan, attach the install notes to the device record.

Diego Morales: appreciate the quick help everyone! ready to start coding :rocket:
